She touches her hair with her right hand while looking directly into the lens, her lips moving continuously. (2) The camera cuts to an extreme close-up of a hand holding a transparent square cosmetic compact containing shimmery eyeshadow. The hand rotates the compact to show the back label with black printed text. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the sparkles. (3) Returning to the medium shot, the woman holds the open compact and uses her index finger to dab the shimmery brown material onto her eyelid. Her facial expression is focused, and the background remains the wooden closet filled with neutral-toned clothing. (4) A close-up shot transitions to show the back of a hand resting on a white, textured fabric surface. A shimmering, earth-toned eyeshadow swatch is visible on the skin, glinting under the light to demonstrate its texture and reflectivity to the viewer. (5) The woman appears again in a medium shot, her lips moving while she maintains a pleasant and smiling expression. She tilts her head slightly to the side, allowing the light to catch the glitter on her eyes. The camera remains static and eye-level.
